about_the_game:
CriminalZ is a co-op crime sandbox set in a decaying future city where survival means doing whatever it takes to pay the Boss and stay out of jail. Dive into a neon-soaked slum, pick your hustle, and build your own criminal story – alone or with friends.

You wake up with nothing. No memories, just a debt you never asked for. The Boss doesn’t care. With every “stage” she demands a higher cash quota. Fail, and you’ll rot in jail. Succeed, and the city opens up to you – more districts, more risk, more reward.

Search dumpsters and back alleys for scrap, pull off high-risk heists, hack corporate systems, or deal Woosh to desperate citizens. Every action raises your Crime Points, drawing the attention of an adaptive police force that will chase, scan, trap you – and eventually teleport you straight into a high-security prison if you’re not careful.

Key Features

Multiple Criminal Roles

Hacker – Disable cameras, crack terminals, and siphon valuables from locked systems.
Breaker – Smash safes, cash registers, and reinforced doors to reach hidden loot.
Stealer – Pick pockets, rob apartments, and swipe valuables right in front of citizens.
Dealer – Grow Woosh in your base, refine it, and sell it to different citizen types for varying prices.

Heists & Risky Gambles

Enter dedicated heist locations with unique layouts, objectives, and higher-tier rewards. Or visit the shady Gamble Machine to risk your hard-earned items for value multipliers, dupes… or total destruction.

Living, Reactive City

Citizens patrol, complain, call the cops if they catch you doing something shady, and panic when things escalate. At night, hostile criminals roam the streets, hunting you down with knives and dirty tricks.

Dynamic Police System

Your actions raise your wanted level. Cops will notice you faster, chase you harder, and use advanced tools like homing orbs that drag you back toward them. If your “caught” bar fills up, you end up in jail – unless another player pays to buy you out.

Jail & Base Loop

Get thrown into jail, serve your time, or hope a teammate bribes the system to free you. Back in your base, you manage loot, refine Woosh, gamble items, plan the next heist, and slowly push toward the next district and the next quota from the Boss.

Co-op Multiplayer

Team up, split roles, and coordinate heists – or be the one who always drags the police into the wrong street. CriminalZ is built around communication, cooperation, and shared chaos.

Early Access – Built with the Community

CriminalZ is being developed solo and actively shaped by player feedback. Systems, balance, and content will continue to evolve: more districts, more heists, MaskZ cosmetics, new enemy types, and events are already planned.

Crime Tiers of the City

Explore multiple districts, each more dangerous – and more profitable – than the last. Early districts are low risk and low reward; later districts offer high-value loot, tougher enemies, and much heavier police presence.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains stylized violence, criminal activity, drug references, and strong language. Not suitable for all ages.
Players may encounter depictions of illegal acts such as theft, drug dealing, and police chases. The tone may include dark humor and toxic interactions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for optimal performance

short_description: An online co-op heist roguelite for up to 4 players. Steal valuable loot, upgrade your gear, and extract to meet your boss’s demands... or die. Avoid the cops, adapt your strategy, and repeat. A crime roguelite where chaos, communication, and strategy go hand in hand. Do you dare?
